_note: Where to grind EXP, from Game8's leveling guide. Tiers use Game8's level ranges; a spot counts as 'good for you now' inside its tier's range (from 3 levels under it) and 'out-leveled' once you are more than 6 levels past it (Game8: farming stops paying off 6 to 10 levels above an area's strongest demon). 'anyLevel' spots are never out-leveled. 'unlockedBy' is a story.json milestone id: the spot is dimmed until that milestone is available or done (null = always reachable). Everything here is unverified until confirmed in-game.
source: Game8, "Leveling Guide: Best Leveling Areas" (HD Remaster, 17 June 2021): https://game8.co/games/Shin-Megami-Tensei-III-Nocturne/archives/332213

spots.name: Radio Tower area (world map)
spots.when: After you arrive in Ginza. Follow the highway east of Ginza on the world map.
tips: Level 30+ demons.
Phys or Dark skills and demons handle these enemies easily.
Badb Catha's Wing Buffet hits hard: run from it at lower levels unless the party has Electricity magic.
Divine demons here can use instant-kill Light magic, so save often.

spots.name: Place Where the Demi-Fiend Was Born
spots.when: Once you reach Ginza and the Amala Link is unlocked. Needs the Mercy and Expectation Map Pack DLC.
tips: Good at all levels.
Mitama demons always drop a Grimoire; flee battles without them.
Grimoire (Thin) gives a set amount of EXP; Grimoire (Thick) gives enough EXP to level up.
Bring a healer with Dia or Media to heal between battles.

spots.name: Kabukicho Prison
tips: One of the best mid-game spots without the DLC.
Mizuchi and Raiju are fragile but give good EXP.
Use Riberama to chain encounters.

spots.name: Yoyogi Park, Construction Site
spots.when: Best after clearing Sakahagi's presence from the park.
tips: Titania is a high-level Fairy that gives good EXP.
Chain battles with Riberama to gain a few levels before continuing the story.

spots.name: Amala Temple, courtyard outside the three temples
enemies: Troll, Oberon, Titania, Suparna, Virtue, Dominion, Legion, Aquans
tips: Mid to late game.
Many high-level enemies with few resistances, so most Demi-fiend builds work.
A nearby Amala Drum Network sits in a safe zone: warp out to heal and come back.
Recruiting Dominion here opens late-game Seraph and Divine demons.

spots.name: Diet Building
tips: Useful while testing endings, or for grinding if you aren't ready to enter the Tower of Kagutsuchi.

spots.name: Fifth Kalpa, B1
enemies: Hua Po, Nyx, Lilith, Aciel, Abaddon, Loki
tips: Nyx and Lilith give strong EXP even at high levels.
Keep demons with revival and healing skills outside the active party.

spots.name: Tower of Kagutsuchi
tips: Among the best EXP in the game: some of its highest-level demons spawn here.
Little story is left, so use it to prepare for boss fights, especially for the True Demon ending.
Entering the Tower before finishing the Labyrinth locks the Labyrinth, and with it True Demon and Pierce (story planner).

tips.title: Riberama
tips.text: Raises the encounter rate until the next new Kagutsuchi; on Normal you may fight every two steps. Pair it with Auto-Battle.

tips.title: Merciful difficulty
tips.text: Roughly 3x to 4x EXP per battle. Its low encounter rate needs offsetting, e.g. with Riberama. Switching difficulty doesn't affect saves; the DLC is a free download.

tips.title: Farm by level
tips.text: Skip an area once you are 6 to 10 levels above its strongest demon; the EXP isn't worth it.

tips.title: AOE demons
tips.text: Spells that hit all enemies clear mobs easily, especially on weaknesses. Pixie's Zio can sometimes become Mazio.

tips.title: Protect the Demi-fiend
tips.text: Demons can be revived, but if the Demi-fiend dies it's game over. Watch his HP during Auto-Battle.

tips.title: Strength
tips.text: The Demi-fiend excels at physical skills, so investing in Strength helps against tougher enemies.
